title: Spectra — Radar Chart Studio
description: Build multi-axis radar charts by dragging points directly on the canvas, compare entities, and export PNG, JSON, or a share link.
concept: A comparison-chart builder for RPG stats, product features, skill sets, or player ratings. Pick a preset or start blank, add entities and axes, then drag each polygon's vertices right on the chart to set values — no sliders needed. Switch themes, grid styles, and fill mode live.
features: Direct-manipulation radar chart — drag vertices on canvas to set values per axis
Add/remove/rename entities and axes on the fly (3–10 axes, unlimited entities)
5 presets: RPG Party Stats, Product Comparison, Skill Radar, Player Ratings, Blank Canvas
4 color themes, filled/outline toggle, circular vs web grid, adjustable ring count
Export as PNG, export/import as JSON, and shareable URL (state encoded in the hash)
Autosaves to localStorage; reloads your last chart on return

interaction.mouse: Drag a vertex dot on the active entity's polygon to change that axis's value; click a chip to switch the active entity
interaction.click: Click entity/axis chips to select, swatches to recolor/retheme, action buttons to export or share
interaction.touch: Same drag-to-set interaction with enlarged touch targets on the vertex handles
interaction.keyboard: Standard tab/enter navigation through controls; double-click (or tap) a chip name to rename
